After you create the function, you can test it by adding a new record to the data stream using the
AWS CLI:
aws kinesis put-record --stream-name test --data "My test data." --partition-key
partitionKey1 --region us-west-1
Then use the OpenSearch Service console or OpenSearch Dashboards to verify that lambda-
kine-index contains a document. You can also use the following request:
Loading streaming data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
1455
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
